title: Hosted MCP server for staff and readers
description: Authenticated Streamable HTTP with site-bound rotating OAuth grants, typed staff tools and existing reader actions. Public discovery stays on HTTP. Verify with the seeded protocol harness before host trials.

comments.text: Re-parented 2026-10-21 from PPY-bcfd2d to the headless-delivery epic PPY-29da48 (Markus for everything).
